name: Mariner's Armor

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: A Swim Speed equal to your Speed; if you start your turn underwater at 0 Hit Points, you rise 60 ft.
text: Blue and green, this armor is decorated with fish and shell motifs. While wearing it, you have a Swim Speed equal to your Speed. Whenever you start your turn underwater with 0 Hit Points, the armor causes you to rise 60 feet toward the surface.
